data.title: 神尾观铃 · 苍穹长堤上的展翼飞奔
data.description: 海天一色的盛夏海岸长堤上，观铃张开双臂像雏鸟般摇晃奔跑，仿佛下一刻就要飞入那辽阔的长空。淡黄荷叶裙摆随海风高高翻卷，笑颜宛若天使。
data.location: sunlit coastal seawall stretching toward an endless cerulean ocean and sky
data.action: running joyfully along concrete breakwater with arms outstretched like airplane wings, sundress fluttering, ecstatic radiant smile
data.lighting: 盛夏纯白艳阳与波光反射
data.promptProse: Misuzu runs gleefully along the ocean breakwater with arms spread wide like wings, the sea breeze whipping around her beneath the open sky.
data.animaCaption: Dazzling summer sun illuminates her outstretched arms as she runs along the seawall toward the horizon.
